mountain_path.name: Mountain Path
mountain_path.description: Rocky switchback trail ascending from Coppervale. Narrow paths between rock walls, snow patches.

alpine_meadow.name: Alpine Meadow
alpine_meadow.description: Open mountain meadow with boulders. Old military wreckage, Aetheric Ore deposits.

bunker_entrance.name: Bunker Entrance
bunker_entrance.description: Hidden in rock face. Sealed military bunker door. Cannot be opened in Year 1.

terrain_features.description: Steep mountain rock walls along path.
Snow patches on the path. Visual detail, no gameplay effect.
Crashed Old World military supply vehicle. Salvageable.
Sealed military bunker door. Massive, military-grade. Cannot be opened in Year 1.
